component.name: Pocket Sense
component.summary: Private, offline money tracker in Jordanian dinars

description.p: Pocket Sense tracks your income, spending, budgets and bills without an account and without the internet. Everything stays on your computer in an encrypted database. It leaves only as an encrypted backup, or, if you turn on sync, encrypted to your own paired devices on your Wi-Fi.

ul.li: No sign-in, no servers, no ads, no analytics. The network is used only to sync with your own devices on your local network, and only if you turn that on.
Your data is encrypted with SQLCipher, using a key kept in your desktop keyring.
Optional app lock with a 4–6 digit PIN.

description.p: Made for Jordan: amounts in Jordanian dinars with three decimals, and a full Arabic interface, right to left.

ul.li: Home: this month's income, spending and net, a 30-day spending chart and a breakdown by category.
Activity: add, edit, search and filter transactions, with merchant, category and notes.
Budgets: weekly or monthly limits per category, with progress and over-budget warnings.
Recurring: bills, subscriptions and salary with due dates, posted as transactions in one click.
Backup: export everything to a password-encrypted file, or back up automatically once a day.
Sync: pair your computer with your phone and keep the same data on both over your Wi-Fi.

description.p: Voice entry, available in the other Linux downloads, isn't included in this version.

description.p: On some phones, reopening the app could lose the encryption key. Keystore errors now show "Try again" and never delete anything, and with a PIN set the app stays locked if the keystore can't be read.
